It started as whispers. I couldn't make out the words. But last night, I heard my name clearly. Then scratching. Then a voice saying "Let me out. I'm so close."

I answered. Static at first, then her voice: "I'm not dead, I'm just somewhere else. Please come get me."

The call ended with a scream. The first night, it was facing the wall. The second night, it was on the floor. This morning, it was sitting on my chest when I woke up, staring at me with those dead glass eyes.

I threw it in the trash outside. Now I keep all mirrors covered. But yesterday, I caught my phone screen reflection winking at me.
